acceptedDeferral.condition: Deploy the current Nova and Buster images and pass the signed Nova-to-Buster HTTP preflight.

HEALTH-ARCH-001.rationale: A versioned provider contract replaces the special health suite name.

HEALTH-ARCH-002.rationale: The declared plan graph controls HTTP test order explicitly.

HEALTH-ARCH-003.rationale: Each consumer declares its HTTP dependency in the plan graph.

HEALTH-ARCH-004.rationale: The provider receives only the named network.http capability.

HEALTH-ARCH-005.rationale: Both implementations require another component to start the target.

HEALTH-ARCH-006.rationale: The replacement performs HTTP requests without browser automation.

HEALTH-CONF-001.rationale: Typed provider configuration replaces the shared serve object.

HEALTH-CONF-002.rationale: The replacement uses an explicit endpoint instead of a serve type.

HEALTH-CONF-003.rationale: The target endpoint now supplies its actual port explicitly.

HEALTH-CONF-004.rationale: The target endpoint now supplies its actual port explicitly.

HEALTH-CONF-005.rationale: An explicit allowed origin selects the required target port.

HEALTH-CONF-006.rationale: The replacement still defaults the request path to root.

HEALTH-CONF-007.rationale: The common runner owns the declared retry count and attempts.

HEALTH-CONF-008.rationale: The common runner owns retry timing instead of provider configuration.

HEALTH-CONF-009.rationale: The replacement request timeout defaults to 10000 milliseconds.

HEALTH-CONF-010.rationale: Independent HTTP nodes replace the implicit smoke path loop.

HEALTH-CONF-011.rationale: Each HTTP node owns one direct response-text assertion.

HEALTH-CONF-012.rationale: The provider accepts only bounded absolute request paths.

HEALTH-CONF-013.rationale: A text assertion cannot exist without its owning HTTP node.

HEALTH-CONF-014.rationale: Expected response text must remain a non-empty string.

HEALTH-HTTP-001.rationale: The replacement sends real HTTP GET requests by default.

HEALTH-HTTP-002.rationale: Operator allowlists replace the fixed localhost-only target rule.

HEALTH-HTTP-003.rationale: The provider sends one bounded configurable Accept header.

HEALTH-HTTP-004.rationale: The capability aborts requests when the declared timeout expires.

HEALTH-HTTP-005.rationale: The replacement reads the bounded response body for assertions.

HEALTH-HTTP-006.rationale: The default assertion accepts every status from 200 through 299.

HEALTH-HTTP-007.rationale: A non-success status fails after the runner exhausts retries.

HEALTH-HTTP-008.rationale: A connection failure produces a failed HTTP test result.

HEALTH-HTTP-009.rationale: The plan declares retries while the runner records every attempt.

HEALTH-HTTP-010.rationale: The common runner controls bounded retry scheduling consistently.

HEALTH-HTTP-011.rationale: The common runner stops retrying after the first passing result.

HEALTH-HTTP-012.rationale: The plan graph controls sequential or parallel HTTP test execution.

HEALTH-HTTP-013.rationale: Each HTTP node declares its own bounded retry policy.

HEALTH-HTTP-014.rationale: A rejected status creates a high-severity test finding.

HEALTH-HTTP-015.rationale: A connection failure creates a high-severity test finding.

HEALTH-HTTP-016.rationale: The response-text assertion passes when the body contains its value.

HEALTH-RES-001.rationale: A successful HTTP node reports one passed check.

HEALTH-RES-002.rationale: A failed HTTP node reports one failed check and finding.

HEALTH-RES-003.rationale: Each request has a separate node result and evidence record.

HEALTH-RES-004.rationale: Provider details record URL, status, size, digest, and duration.

HEALTH-RES-005.rationale: A failed HTTP assertion fails its blocking plan node.

HEALTH-RES-006.rationale: Invalid request paths fail with a stable HTTP configuration code.

HEALTH-RES-007.rationale: Invalid assertion configuration fails before any network request.

HEALTH-RES-008.rationale: The provider logs the method and target while the runner logs attempts.

HEALTH-RES-009.rationale: The result stores only bounded metadata and a body digest.

HEALTH-RES-010.rationale: Independent execution remains controlled by the shared plan graph.

HEALTH-DEFECT-001.rationale: The capability enforces declared and streamed response byte limits.

HEALTH-DEFECT-002.rationale: The capability honors cancellation during request and body reads.

HEALTH-DEFECT-003.rationale: Schemas and runtime checks validate every numeric execution limit.

HEALTH-DEFECT-004.rationale: Provider findings use consistent severity and failed-count metadata.
